name: noi2contiamo
description: Contabilità di coppia e di famiglia, open source e self hosted: spese condivise, import CSV, regole automatiche, dashboard.
author: Matteo Filippini

scripts.dev:local: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @noi2contiamo/web" "node scripts/uv.mjs run --project server uvicorn noi2contiamo_server.main:app --reload --port 8000"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @noi2contiamo/web
scripts.build:firebase: npm run typecheck && npm run build:firebase -w @noi2contiamo/web
scripts.demo: node scripts/uv.mjs run --project server python -m noi2contiamo_server.demo
scripts.local: npm run build && node scripts/uv.mjs run --project server python -m noi2contiamo_server
scripts.lint: npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:py
scripts.lint:py: node scripts/uv.mjs run --project server ruff check server && node scripts/uv.mjs run --project server ruff format --check server
scripts.lint:fix: eslint . --fix && prettier --write . && node scripts/uv.mjs run --project server ruff check --fix server && node scripts/uv.mjs run --project server ruff format server
scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:scripts && npm run test:py
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.test:py: node scripts/uv.mjs run --project server pytest server/tests
scripts.test:rules: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.34 emulators:exec --only auth,firestore "npx vitest run --project data src/contract/firebase.test.ts"
scripts.deploy:firebase: npm run build:firebase && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.34 deploy --only hosting,firestore
scripts.bank:csv: node scripts/uv.mjs run --project server python -m noi2contiamo_server.bank_cli
scripts.deploy:firebase:functions: npm run build:functions && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.34 deploy --only functions
